name: Auberdine
summary: Ships crowd Auberdine's docks, carrying travelers between Darkshore, Teldrassil, and the Eastern Kingdoms. The night elven town is the Alliance's main port in northern Kalimdor, between the Veiled Sea and pine-covered bluffs.

sections.title: Gateway to Northern Kalimdor
sections.body: Auberdine stands on the Veiled Sea, the only major settlement still thriving in Darkshore. Ships sail to Stormwind Harbor and, by way of Southshore, to Menethil Harbor. Ferries cross to Rut'theran Village beneath the boughs of the World Tree. Unlike Teldrassil's secluded treetop cities, Auberdine welcomes travelers from across the sea. Lamps light its stone streets, where dwarves and gnomes mingle with merchants among low, arched timber houses.

sections.title: A Beleaguered Haven
sections.body: Elder Thundris Windweaver and the Auberdine Village Council govern the town. They coordinate Darkshore's defense with the local Sentinels. Auberdine is a vital trade hub, though Darnassus rarely speaks its name; memory there dwells on the great cities lost to the Sundering. Trouble presses from every side. Aggressive murlocs raid fishing boats along the strand, corrupted Blackwood furbolgs push from the south, and foul magic drifting down from Felwood agitates the wildlife.

faq.q: Where do the ships in Auberdine go?
faq.answer: Auberdine's docks connect northern Kalimdor with the wider Alliance world. A ferry crosses to Rut'theran Village at Teldrassil's base. Ocean-going ships cross the Great Sea to Stormwind Harbor and, by way of Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills, to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Elder Thundris Windweaver and the Auberdine Village Council govern Auberdine. The Sentinels oversee its defense, led locally by Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea.

faq.q: Why are there dwarves and humans living in a night elf town?
faq.answer: Auberdine is the Alliance's chief port in northern Kalimdor, so foreign traders, craftsmen, and travelers arrive there first. Dwarves keep a smithy to serve visiting ships and travelers. The town is unusually diverse beside traditional night elf settlements.

faq.q: Why do night elves from Darnassus look down on Auberdine?
faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver calls Auberdine a humble place whose name is not spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most kaldorei remember the cities lost to the Sundering, including the thriving Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran, and Auberdine remains in their shadow.

angles.text: As a kaldorei venturing out from Teldrassil, you reach Auberdine as your first true mainland hub. Here, ancient tradition meets the unfamiliar ways and industry of younger Alliance allies.
As an Alliance traveler, you rely on this port to carry people and supplies into northern Kalimdor, linking Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus.
